2023_048_feb_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Monthly procurement-card (PCARD) transaction listing for the Troy School District covering February 2023, carried on the Board of Education agenda for the April 18, 2023 meeting. Every page repeats the heading TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, February 2023 and the columns Transaction Description, JE Description, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount and Credits, with a print date of 4/13/2023 running through page 37. Rows post to general fund, grant, special education, adult education, community, capital and student activity budget units under the journal entry description FEB PCARD EXP. The listing closes with a Subtotal of 292,056.59 against 4,226.85 in credits and Total Expenses of 287,829.74.
2023_048_feb_2023_pcard_report.page:
Identity and format
Procurement-card (PCARD) activity report of the Troy School District for February 2023, presented with the April 18, 2023 Board of Education meeting materials. The report is a repeating tabular listing headed TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, February 2023, with column headings Transaction Description, JE Description, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount and Credits reprinted on each page and a footer page number followed by the print date 4/13/2023, ending at page 37. Each row shows a transaction date paired with a truncated merchant name (for example 2/3/2023-C & G PUBLIS or 1/27/2023-AMZN MKTP US), a uniform journal entry description of FEB PCARD EXP, a budget unit, an account code, and an entry in either the Transaction Amount or the Credits column. Transaction dates range from 1/26/2023 through 2/27/2023.

Spending patterns
Amazon entities (AMZN MKTP US, AMAZON.COM and its lettered variants) dominate the line count across nearly every building and program unit, alongside Staples order numbers (STAPLS737xxx and STAPLS760xxx), School Specialty, Demco, Flinn Scientific, Blick Art Materials, Lakeshore Learning and Gordon Food Service. Travel and conference charges post through Delta, Allianz Travel, Marriott, Hyatt Regency, Amway Grand, Courtyard, Belleclaire, Drury Inns, Sheraton Ann Arbor, Crystal Mountain and Grand Traverse Resort. Professional association and training charges include MASB 953.00, MI ASSOC SCH 1,075.00, MSBO charges of 540.00, 510.00, 205.00, 180.00, 360.00 and 90.00, ONLC Training at 1,250.00 and 1,730.00, and Oakland Schools registrations at 105.00, 150.00, 70.00, 35.00 and 25.00.

Credits
The Credits column carries returns and refunds, the largest being MARRIOTT COP 407.58 on 2/2/2023 and NSBA credits of 500.00 dated 2/9/2023 (account 3220) and 2/14/2023 (account 3210). Smaller credits include AMZN MKTP US 136.89, 129.99, 101.12, 79.99, 55.45 and 45.99, AMAZON.COM 54.00 and 18.02, DBC*BLICK AR 87.96, APPLE STORE 468.94, HC* HC_CHARG 85.15, AUTOZONE 437 90.00, GK ELITE 136.00, RIDLEY'S BAK 50.14, BEST BUY 30.75, EPIC SPORTS 20.99, SCHOOL HEALT 15.30, and a run of THRIFT BOOKS credits on 2/16/2023 ranging from 0.21 to 0.40 in unit 101053112042500.

Fund coverage
Budget units span the 101 general fund building and department codes, 120 and 122 grant and special education codes, 419 capital codes, 529 adult program codes, 530 and 531 community and childcare codes, and 700 and 701 student activity and agency codes. Account codes used include 3120, 3190, 3210, 3220, 3410, 3430, 3450, 3510, 3610, 4120, 4130, 4220, 5000, 5110, 5310, 5910, 5990, 6410, 7410 and 7910.
